paragraphs.chinese:
这一集完全围绕恐惧展开。孩子们害怕各种不同的东西，但大人其实同样害怕，只是更擅长假装自己不怕。

菲尔和卢克觉得，他们家房子下面可能藏着某种宝藏。两个人都很兴奋，想下去寻找，但菲尔其实非常害怕下面黑暗狭窄的空间和各种虫子。他没有亲自进去，而是给卢克的遥控卡车装上一台摄像机，让它开进下面探路。

菲尔失去了对卡车的控制，卢克很难过，因为那是杰送给他的圣诞礼物。卢克最后亲自爬到房子下面找车，结果腰带被一根管道卡住了。菲尔一听说儿子被困住，立刻忘记了自己的恐惧，爬进去救他。

菲尔帮卢克脱困后，两个人决定继续一起探索。他们很快发现了几具看起来像尸体的东西，吓得尖叫着逃了出来。警察赶到后才发现，那些所谓的尸体只是前任房主留下的旧万圣节装饰。

与此同时，海莉正在第三次参加驾驶考试。她紧张得不得了，克莱尔让她做三次深呼吸，放松下来。不幸的是，海莉又遇到了之前让她不及格的那个严格考官。

考试过程中，海莉情绪彻底崩溃，开始哭了起来。考官承认，海莉让他想起自己的女儿，而这正是他希望她真正学会安全驾驶的原因。他给了海莉另一次机会，她终于通过了考试。可她庆祝时差点又出事，因为她忘了把车挂进停车挡。

亚历克斯也在为学校舞会紧张，因为她害怕没有人会邀请自己跳舞。克莱尔给了她和海莉一样的建议：做三次深呼吸，然后放松。

在杰和格洛丽亚家，曼尼假装生病，想逃避一场在游乐园举办的生日派对。格洛丽亚知道他真正害怕的是过山车，于是和杰一起把他骗了过去。格洛丽亚告诉曼尼，他必须面对恐惧，随后却发现杰其实也怕过山车。曼尼拒绝在没有杰陪伴的情况下乘坐，于是杰最后只好和他一起上去。

米切尔和卡梅隆邀请莉莉的儿科医生来家里吃早午餐，因为他们想成为医生最喜欢的病人家庭。吃饭时，莉莉突然说了一声“妈妈”。卡梅隆非常受伤，开始担心莉莉是不是需要一个母亲。

医生告诉他们，莉莉很幸运，拥有两个如此关心她的父亲。后来，他们发现莉莉的玩偶被挤压时会发出“妈妈”的声音。莉莉只是模仿了这个声音，两位父亲也都松了一口气。

到了最后，每个人依然害怕某样东西。但无论是黑暗的地下空间、过山车、驾驶考试，还是担心自己能不能成为好父母，只要有人陪在身边，一切都会变得容易一些。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is all about fear. The children are afraid of different things, but the adults are just as scared and are much better at pretending they aren’t.

Phil and Luke believe there may be some kind of treasure hidden under their house. They’re both excited to look for it, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark space and the insects under there. Instead of going in, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck down with a camera attached to it.

Phil loses control of the truck, and Luke is upset because it was a Christmas present from Jay. Luke finally crawls under the house to get it himself, but his belt gets caught on a pipe. As soon as Phil hears that his son is trapped, he forgets about his own fear and goes in to help him.

After Phil frees Luke, they decide to keep exploring together. They soon find what look like dead bodies and run out screaming. The police arrive, but the bodies turn out to be old Halloween decorations left by the previous owner.

Meanwhile, Haley is taking her driving test for the third time. She’s so nervous that Claire tells her to take three deep breaths and relax. Unfortunately, Haley gets the same strict examiner who failed her before.

During the test, Haley becomes overwhelmed and starts crying. The examiner admits that she reminds him of his own daughter, which is exactly why he wants her to become a safe driver. He gives her another chance, and she finally passes. Her celebration almost ends badly when she forgets to put the car in park.

Alex is also nervous about going to a school dance because she’s afraid no one will ask her to dance. Claire gives her the same advice she gave Haley: take three deep breaths and relax.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny pretends to be sick so he can avoid a birthday party at an amusement park. Gloria knows he’s really afraid of the roller coaster, so she and Jay trick him into going. Gloria tells Manny he needs to face his fear, but then she discovers that Jay is scared too. Manny refuses to ride without him, so Jay finally gets on with him.

Mitchell and Cameron invite Lily’s pediatrician over for brunch because they want to become her favorite patients. During the meal, Lily suddenly says “Mommy.” Cameron is heartbroken and starts worrying that Lily needs a mother.

The doctor tells them that Lily is lucky to have two fathers who care so much about her. Later, they discover that Lily’s doll says “Mommy” when it’s squeezed. Lily was only copying the sound, and both fathers are relieved.

By the end, everyone is still afraid of something. But whether it’s a dark space, a roller coaster, a driving test, or being a good parent, it becomes easier when someone is there with you.
